notablePrerequisites:
Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
It is your turn.
description:
Activate Elite Arcanist by paying {0} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pact of the Titan without paying its mana cost.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Elite Arcanist.
Resolve Pact of the Titan, creating a 4/4 Giant creature token.When the Giant enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Giant, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
